turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I was wondering if we could start with you telling us what brought you in?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Sure, I've had this terrible headache for the past four days. Doesn't seem to be getting any better, and I feel hot like I have a fever. I've been coughing a lot so I am I'm worried I have COVID, so I'm here.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. So I'll start with the headaches. When did when did that exactly started?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh the headache started, OK so the coughing started four days ago. The headache started shortly after so I would say later on during that day and then the fever I've had for, fever I think I've had for the past two days. I haven't actually taken my temperature though.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK um. So, uh, the cough is started four days ago. Has the cough gotten better, worse, or stayed the same?

turns.text: The cough has stayed the same.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, are you bringing up any phlegm or sputum with the cough?

turns.text: Mmmm

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Oh OK, are you, OK, are you seeing this on like kind of tissues afterwards sort of thing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, um and any triggers for the cough you can think of?

turns.label: Patient

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and is the cough there at night time too?

turns.label: Patient

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, um is it interfering with sleep?

turns.label: Patient

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, um, and with your cough have you had any difficulties with breathing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, no.

turns.text: OK, um have you had headaches like this before?

turns.text: OK, uh is the headache associated with any nausea or vomiting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.text: OK, and is the headache worse in the morning when you first wake up?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Patient

turns.text: OK. Um and, um and you haven't checked the temperature yet, you said, but you felt hot?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.text: OK, any other symptoms that you've been experiencing?

So we will test for that and check a PCR nasal swab for COVID. I'm not, but we will also test for other viral illnesses and bacterial illnesses as well. It doesn't sound like you have meningitis right now just based on the symptoms where you don't have neck stiffness, but it'll be certainly something that we keep keep in mind while we are doing our investigations.
